title: Vietnamese Pineapple Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry dish made with juicy Vietnamese chicken, pineapple, and a hint of spice. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in a mixture of soy sauce, fish sauce, honey, and red pepper flakes for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pineapple to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until tender.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the pineapple and sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
